reviews.text:
I am incredibly disappointed in Pet Mechanic after five years of entrusting them with the care of my dog.

My 18-year-old dachshund has now experienced two episodes of sudden collapse and seizure-like convulsions within approximately two weeks. Today, she vomited, collapsed, and began convulsing. Understandably concerned, I called our longtime veterinarian seeking an urgent evaluation.

I was told the earliest appointment available was Monday at noon — five days from now.

I understand that vets have busy schedules and cannot always accommodate every appointment request. However, after five years as a patient, I would expect a greater level of responsiveness when my elderly dog is experiencing potentially serious medical symptoms.

This wasn't a routine wellness visit or a minor concern. This was an 18-year-old dog experiencing unexplained episodes of collapse and convulsions.

After five years of loyalty to this practice, being unable to secure a timely evaluation when my dog needs medical attention is profoundly disappointing.

The true measure of a vet isn't simply how it handles routine appointments. It's how it responds when an animal needs help.

Unfortunately, today's experience has seriously undermined my confidence in this practice.

The saddest day of my life and the staff was beyond exceptional.

On my furbabies 13th birthday, I had to make the difficult decision to have my Ozzie euthanized because of congested heart failure.   The staff and the consult room were beyond comforting during this difficult time.  Thank you ALL for being so accommodating and comforting during this difficult time.

I recently brought my 9 year old reactive pittie here after going to a different vet for years. They are so kind and not judgmental whatsoever to my nervous girl and I. Vet tech Kim and Dr. Lily were extremely thorough and I finally feel like all my concerns are addressed and taken seriously. Highly recommend!!

I am posting this because of something I personally witnessed at The Pet Mechanic – Fishtown that left me extremely disturbed.

While I was at the practice, I personally witnessed Letitia Borelli, the Practice Manager, handling a cat in the back treatment area. I observed her aggressively grab and squeeze the cat around the neck area and then kick the cat.

I want to be very clear that I am describing what I personally witnessed. I am not speculating about her intentions. Seeing an animal handled this way was extremely concerning to me, especially inside a veterinary facility where people entrust their pets to staff for their care and safety.

I have reported what I witnessed to the appropriate animal-welfare authorities so that it can be independently investigated.

I also have concerns regarding fundraising associated with Tulip’s Timestamps, a feline rescue associated with Tish Borelli. Those concerns have been/will be reported separately to the appropriate organizations for independent review. I am not stating that financial wrongdoing has been established, only that I believe the fundraising concerns warrant review.

I am sharing my firsthand experience because pet owners deserve to make informed decisions about where they entrust their animals.

The vet care has not been a problem but they price gauge heavily on their pharmacy. I would recommend getting your prescriptions filled elsewhere. I paid $30 for 10 pills of carprofen which is basically Advil for dogs. Felt taken advantage of when my dog need basic pain meds.
Thank you for the review, Randall!
The most empathetic, efficient and kind vet team ever and I've had a lot of experience :) my dog drags me here

We switched veterinarians to have a location closer to home for our cats, and The Pet Mechanic was highly recommended. They are so friendly and welcoming, and you can tell they truly care about their patients. We didn’t feel rushed, and both the vet tech, Michaela, and Dr.Smith took the time to explain every step and answer our questions. They were even super kind and patient with our girl Martha, who can get a pretty spicy when she’s anxious. Going to the vet can be nerve wracking, so a friendly team really makes all the difference!

I just established care with them for my cat and the appointment could not have gone better. She can be nervous and spicy with strangers and her visit required some procedures done in the exam room. The technician and the vet did an amazing job gently but firmly and confidently handling her so that she and they were kept safe. They were up front about pricing, answered all of my questions, and came up with a treatment plan I feel good about. The office staff were also so kind. I am so relieved to have found this great office and will be back for regular care for my cat.

After a less than ideal experience with a vet at this practice, I was hesitant to return. However Michaela and Dr Harris have been so incredibly kind, patient and knowledgeable it’s really turned around my entire perspective. I feel so grateful we decided to give it another chance. With a nervous cat there is nothing more reassuring than someone as lovely as Michaela. A vet experience can be so stressful but it’s so wonderful knowing Michaela is taking care of our cat as if he was her own. Thank you to Michaela and Dr Harris for everything they have done for Weston 🐈

Would absolutely recommend Dr. Harris and our favorite vet tech Michaela. Our old boy is not great with high stress situations, but his thyroid issues require us to make frequent visits. We never feel rushed and Michaela’s calm, sweet bedside manner puts our cat (and us) at ease.
Great team and very patient with my anxious boy

Our first visit to this practice was excellent. The veterinarian we saw was kind, compassionate, and made me feel truly heard, which gave me confidence that we had found a great veterinary office after moving to the area.
Unfortunately, my experience during our dog’s final days were very different. I brought our senior dog in for an urgent care visit after a particularly bad night for guidance on keeping him comfortable as his quality of life was declining. While I understand why additional imaging/testing was recommended, I had to explain a few times that my priority was comfort rather than pursuing more diagnostics, and I left feeling like those concerns weren't truly heard.
Just days later, my dog declined rapidly and passed away. When I called to cancel what I had been told was his scheduled follow-up appointment, I was surprised to learn it had never actually been scheduled. After sharing that he had passed away, the phone conversation felt abrupt and dismissive, adding a level of frustration during an already heartbreaking time.
End-of-life care requires not only medical knowledge but also compassion and attention to detail. Sadly, those were the things I felt were missing during one of the hardest experiences a pet owner can go through. Because of this I would not recommend this office to someone with a senior pet looking for care.

We love Pet Mechanic. They give the best care to our dog, Duncan. And treat him so well. Duncan is reactive, and they are so understanding of his needs. We even moved out of the neighborhood and continue to use Pet Mechanic because the care is top notch.
Thank you for the 5-star review, Katie!

Dr Foley and his team have been treating three of my dogs. He is a great Vet. He does not recommend unnecessary tests or visits. So I have full trust on his recommendations. He has a pleasant disposition which makes working with him easy

So thankful for the Pet Mechanic team in Fishtown! They took the time to listen to my concerns about our aging pup and worked with me to come up with a game plan and different options to keep her comfortable and happy.

7/29: Updating my review to present day to give a hat tip to Michaela and Dr Foley who did an amazing job caring for my ailing pooch and calming me down as the worried Dog Mom. They are very soothing and knowledgeable, and I have so much confidence in Dr Foley’s expertise. Hat tip also to Antonio at the front desk who was able to change our appointment on the fly to get my girlie in sooner. Pet Mechanic is a terrific place for your loving pet at all stages of life.
………………………………..
I had a first-time patient appt for my old gal, who needed a well-visit check up, vaccines etc.  It was so easy scheduling an appt, was promptly greeted on arrival by friendly Front Desk staff, and the Techs/Vet were all wonderful. Very knowledgeable and took time playing with my dog to make her more relaxed. The mobile app is nice too. Would definitely recommend The Pet Mechanic.
